node.title: Re^3: conditional print. Is correct to use it?
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Your complete list of false values is one of those "well known" facts that I cannot find the documentation for.

There [https://perldoc.perl.org/5.26.3/perlsyn.html#Truth-and-Falsehood|used to be] a section in [doc://perlsyn], and I wrote the node [id://11104607] as a replacement.
